meaning:
μόρφωσις, -εως, ἡ
(μορφόω),
1. a forming, shaping (Theophr.).
2. form, outline, semblance: Rom.2:20; opposite to δύναμις, 2Ti.3:5.†
SYN.: μορφή (which see), σχῆμα (AS)

elsewhere.note: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
